caption: The video captures a nighttime parade moving along a brick-paved street bordered by spectators on both sides. A large circular float dominates the center, built from concentric rings of LED dots arranged in a spiral pattern. A winged fairy figure in a green dress is mounted on the wheel's face near its top. As the parade progresses, the fairy stays fixed in that position while surrounding dots brighten and dim. The spiral pattern remains broadly aligned, so the visible change is mainly a shifting pattern of lit points and color. The float's illumination shifts gradually from warm white and orange through pink and magenta into a cooler blue and purple wash. As it travels, the structure appears slightly lower and a little larger, while its center drifts left. In the right foreground a silhouetted spectator drifts leftward toward the center, their outline remaining broadly similar as they cross the view. Crowds along the edges remain largely fixed while the glowing wheel continues changing color and light pattern.
